outputs.explanation: Panel A shows an H&E micrograph and spatial transcriptomics heatmap-style plots overlaid on tissue sections, not a bar/mean plot requiring individual data points.
Panel B consists of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs; no summary statistic plot is shown, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C is a scatter/dot plot of TMPRSS11B expression values for each LUAD and LUSC patient, with individual data points (dots) already displayed alongside the median with 95% CI.
Panel D is a bar chart of mean ± SD qRT-PCR values, with individual data points (colored dots) for each of the n=3 replicates overlaid on the bars.
